title: Python Developer(AWS), Scrum Master, Business Analyst & a Project Co-ordinator!
text: Python Developer(AWS), Scrum Master, Business Analyst & a Project Co-ordinator! at Gestion (Sydney, CBD, Inner West & Eastern Suburbs; Contract/Temp; salary: not stated). Gestion is a Professional Services Company that works within larger listed companies and government organisations to assist them with their Programs of Work. We have some great opportunities with our major clients. To find out more about Gestion,visit our website or should you be looking for a new opportunity and have the appropriate skill set that matches what we do, we are always looking for quality people to join our team. In applying for the opportunity listed the below please send your CV to contact.us@gestion.com.au JOB IN MORE DETAIL Job No 20180441 Python Developer - Full-Stack Software Engineer We are in search of a Python Developer with the ability to leverage numerous programming languages and technologies. You’ll be working on an innovative greenfield project responsible for the build of an award-winning product. This program of work is to develop embedded software on consumer modems to retrieve information about the customer experience. Our clients’ staff have designs and architecture guidelines which will need to be followed. You will need to be proficient in multiple programming languages, & platforms with experience in areas of embedded Linux development as well as web services, with a focus on modern web Service APIs and experience in JSON, web service security design, modern programming techniques including agile methodology. A solid understanding of networking and networking protocols is essential. The focus is on the enhancement of a residential gateway platform. Enhance, productise and integrate with proposed solution components which include Open WRT platform to create a complete end-end systems solution to enable our client to understand the customer experience at home. Enhance, productise and integrate with existing solution components including python based web services and AWS gateway services to create a complete end-end systems solution. Developing structured, clean reusable code is essential. Key Accountabilities: Developing system requirements in collaboration with the development team. Design and build unit tested code modules for new features and enhancements of existing cloud based technology platforms & applications. Apply your development skills to the product design process. Participate in daily scrum meetings and internal developer communications (Agile methodology). Interface with other project stakeholders to ensure that the system objectives are balanced with the overall project objectives. Job No 20180442 Scrum Master - Expertise and Leaderships in the practice of Scrum to develop teams. We are ins search of a Scrum Master to provide subject matter expertise and leadership in the practice of Scrum to lead develop teams; to collaborate with other internal and external partners to facilitate the delivery of programs of work for a major listed client. Key accountabilities: Build a system in the spirit of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) in a setup that acts in a start-up fashion work closely with the development teams to ensure an excellent standard of consultation. Report on deliverables using the Atlassian tool suite and escalating unanticipated variations in scope. Be Responsible for setting, guiding and managing project to its target. Be Responsible for managing time (schedules / phases), cost (actual / budget), resources (internal and external) and content (milestones / targets). Effectively and efficiently manage all aspects of Service Delivery, to meet agreed upon contractual obligations and customer satisfaction. Be responsible for the operational integrity of the delivery. •Engage Activation and Provisioning teams to confirm solutions. Give technical and problem solving support to the team. Act as a link between the project and other interest groups. •Ensure that all elements of the budgeting, cost control and payment processes are implemented and controlled. Manage the relationships with stakeholders such that requirements are clearly defined, progress is reported and expectations are managed. Participate in development and re-engineering of product development processes. Participate in development of policies and procedures of project management. •Implement improved project management practices. Contribute to the development of fellow project managers both individually and as a group. Process progress and performance reports and presents them to the customer. Job No 20180443 Business Analysts x2 – Build Optimised & personalised Customer Journeys We are searching for two agile business analysts to build optimised and personalised digital customer journeys for the existing customer base of one of our major clients. The assignment entails creating a program of work to deliver key digital experiences, working with key business and IT stakeholders to design, build and test, and deliver the digital experiences. The digital experiences entail leveraging existing capability and templates to iteratively role out initiatives. The project activities are small initiatives, which can be developed and rolled out in 3-4 week increments. Technical Skills Assess, prioritise and plan program of work to deliver initiatives Gather, analyse and model business requirements Design optimised end to end customer journeys Document reporting and non-functional requirements Conduct structured, detailed and methodical testing Track, manage and report on campaign outcomes Identify and present campaign learnings and outcomes Generate insight to support decision making and prioritisation of remediation Non-technical Skills Good written and verbal skills Can think laterally and analytically Logical and methodical to develop a plan to deliver key initiatives Structured and outcomes driven Able to work logically and in a structured manner through detailed requirements Proactive (e.g. identification of business improvement opportunities) Communicate clearly (written/verbal) and tailor your message to your audience Comfortable with interpreting meaning from data and developing hypotheses Job No 20180444 Project Coordinator / Administrator - classic Our major client is looking for a Project Administrator/ Coordinator with strong customer service skills, someone who has the ability to prioritise and juggle multiple tasks at once. A friendly personality works very well in this client's environment. No task can be too small and we are looking for resources that can start very soon! Also, a key to this role is to be able to assist the Program Manager prepare work/stakeholder packs in PowerPoint. Being proactive is key! This Project Administration/Coordination resource is responsible for delivering and providing co-ordination activities to the project team throughout the project life cycle. Key Responsibilities Meeting project deadlines and goals as part of a team; Assist with the development and maintenance of project schedules, co-ordinating internal and external project meetings and associated documentation Liaising with key stakeholders, both internal and external; Coordinate resources, and logistics for the project; Management and maintenance of project documents and administration; Manage external vendors that includes analysis, relationship management, and deliverables monitoring and reporting; Project management tasks as directed by the Program Manager Preparing work/stakeholder packs in PowerPoint. Key Skills, Experience and Selection Criteria Demonstrated ability to deliver small to medium projects in a complex and diversified environment; Demonstrated ability in delivering project co-ordination functions; Well-developed communication, organizational and interpersonal skills, as well as diplomacy and confidentiality; Friendly personality an advantage. HR skills an advantage but not essential Proven ability to work successfully in a team environment with excellent customer service skills. Friendly personality an advantage. Highly developed documentation, knowledge and information management skills; ability to prioritise and juggle multiple tasks at once. Highly developed skills in computer literacy, particularly in the area of business productivity products – Microsoft Word, Project, Excel and PowerPoint etc.; A little more about Gestion At Gestion we are dedicated to providing professional consulting services to assist our clients effectively unite business goals, technology, and end-user needs. We provide these services by working with key stakeholders to understand their businesses and placing the right consultants to assist them in their program of work. Our Vision "Gestion" – derived from the French for Stewardship – means "to leave a place in better shape". There is no greater professional reward than being part of the business improvements taking place at our clients, which is our collective measure of success. Our Services Program Management - focus on controls, standards, and communication Project Management - in-depth understanding of PM methodologies delivered with leadership and extensive practical experience Benefits Realisation Management - Consultancy services in developing frameworks and plans as well as measuring of benefits pre and post project implementation to validate ROI Project Review and Assessment - Independent assessment to maximise project success Change - Communication of vision, mission, and strategy with culture change that leads to high performing teams Business Analysis - understand commercial drivers and focus on business case development Requirements Analysis - identify, assess, and communicate stakeholder requirements Process Analysis - clearly articulate integrated business processes Technical Analysis - delivery of technically based documentation Test Management - both systems and UAT Solution Architecture and Development - direction for the design of technical solutions that fulfil business requirements Sales and Marketing – the use of account management to facilitate the promotion of product and service as well as the capture of new business through the business life cycle
